text:
Renee: Quick design follow-up from today's catalog review. Two overlapping problems: the filter summary chip gets buried when many badges appear, and users asked to save a comparison view (filters + pinned versions) so they can return later. Thoughts on small, ship-ready patterns?

Owen: On the filter summary chip: prefer a persistent compact summary in the header that says "Filters: Active (3)" and sits left of the search field. On narrow widths it should collapse to a single icon + count (aria-label: "Active filters, 3"). If users tap it, open the full filter sheet. Keeps affordance visible.

Kai: Save-compare idea: expose a lightweight "Save view" control near the header that serializes the current filters + pinned rows into a url fragment and user-friendly name. UX: clicking "Save view" opens a modal to name it and choose visibility (personal/team). Telemetry: emit event save_view_created.

Priya: Microcopy suggestions: use "Save view" with helper text: "Save filters and pinned versions for quick access". For the header chip, use "Active filters (3)" when >0 else "Filters". Also standardize on "Pin to comparison" everywhere.

Jorge: Accessibility: the compact header chip must be keyboard focusable and announce the count when toggled using an aria-live polite region (e.g., "Filters applied: 3"). For the saved views modal, ensure it traps focus and returns focus to the save button on close. Saved view links need an accessible name for screen readers: "Saved view: <name> opens in current page".

Renee: Regarding badge density: earlier we debated +N overflow vs showing all. For this flow can we show two primary metrics inline (latency, cost) and a secondary summary pill "+N metrics" that opens a popover? That would keep header and summary chip stable.

Owen: Agree. Also propose a tiny animation on opening the popover so the user can perceive the relationship between +N and the list (but respect prefers-reduced-motion). For keyboard, allow arrow navigation inside the popover and Esc to close.

Kai: Implementation note re virtualization: if the save view serializes pinned row IDs not DOM positions, the saved view will still restore correctly even if the list reorders. Avoid serializing indexes. Also saved views should optionally pin rows on load. Pseudocode idea:
```
savePayload = { filters: {...}, pinnedIds: ["m-123", "m-456"], name: "LLM latency check" }
// restore: applyFilters(savePayload.filters); setPinned(savePayload.pinnedIds)
```

Priya: Good call on IDs. Also add hint text in the save modal: "Saved views are private by default; mark as team to share." Keeps expectations clear.

Jorge: Color/contrast nits: the small performance badge greens fail at 12px on AA. Use success-600 and include an icon (arrow/down) + numeric text. Also the +N pill needs a visible focus ring; current focus is only outline without color contrast. Use 2px ring and token focus-ring.

Renee: One more small decision: where does the "Save view" appear on mobile? Suggest it lives in the header overflow (three-dot menu) and when tapped shows "Save current view" which opens a sheet. Avoid adding more buttons in the cramped header.

Owen: Mobile sheet should include a toggle "Pin rows on load" so users decide if saved views should auto-pin. Also provide a small preview summary line: "Filters: 3 • Pinned: 2".

Kai: For keyboard shortcuts (bonus): allow pressing "f" to focus the filter bar and "s" when focused in the header to open the save modal. These should be discoverable via a small "Keyboard shortcuts" tooltip in the profile menu, not inline. Make the shortcuts configurable later.

Priya: Microcopy for save modal confirm button: "Save view" (not "Create"), cancel is "Close". If the name is empty, default to "Untitled view". Also provide an expiration option (never/30 days/90 days) for short-lived experiments.

Jorge: A11y checklist for this feature: 1) saved view modal focus trap, 2) aria-labels for filter chip +N, 3) roving tabindex for badge group when virtualized, 4) announce restore action (aria-live polite "Saved view loaded") so screen reader users understand the state changed.

design-bot: Figma frames uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/.../catalog-save-view-and-filter-chip  comments enabled for @Renee @Owen @Kai @Jorge @Priya.

Renee: Nice. Plan: Owen to prototype header chip + save modal, Kai to spec saved view payload, Priya to finalize copy, Jorge to run the a11y checklist. Aim to land in the minor release. Please drop final nits here by EOD. :sparkles:
